cards.front: Fungal cell wall polymer and mode of nutrition
cards.back: Chitin walls. Absorptive heterotrophs: enzymes are secreted onto the substrate and the small products are absorbed. Carbohydrate is stored as glycogen, as in animals.

cards.front: Order of events in the fungal sexual cycle
cards.back: Plasmogamy (cytoplasms fuse, heterokaryotic stage) → karyogamy (nuclei fuse, brief diploid zygote) → meiosis → haploid spores. Most of the life cycle is haploid.
